svg.title: Figure 2-1: zones of the operating environment as a schematic site plan
svg.desc: A schematic plan on a one-metre grid: the development test area Z1 in green on the left, the transport aisle Z2 in amber across the middle with racks below it, the dock lane Z3 with the dock at its end and the charging bay Z4 on the right, the public corridor Z5 hatched along the top and the loading-dock edge Z0 hatched along the bottom; the robot to scale in Z1 with its one-metre front scanner field and rear bumper; a key explains the colours.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 2-1 Zones of the operating environment (schematic site plan, 1 m grid)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each zone with its people class and speed limit from §2. Only Z1 is inside the case at BL-001. The robot, its 1.0 m starting protective field and the rear bumper are to scale.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Z0 excluded: loading-dock edge (drop), outdoor beyond

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Z5 Shared public floor (showroom, office corridor, visitor route)
